works.body:
Hello! I love your drawing style and I think it is perfect for my original character. Could you please draw her for me?

🕸️ Bali | 170 cm tall | 27 years old
' The only youngest daughter of a wealthy businessman, she was adopted at the age of 9.
' She is strict and noble, and maintains an elegant appearance. However, when spoken to or seen by others, she appears extremely kind and polite. She is very good at putting on an outward demeanor and has played the 'role' of the perfect filial daughter almost her entire life.
' As a matter of fact, she was adopted by her current family only to be a 'sacrifice' in place of her own sons, her brothers. The family is wealthy, but is haunted by a demonic presence that will not rest until it has eradicated every single man of the family's blood.
' Because her spirituality was similar to that of her adopted brothers, she was welcomed as their replacement. But surprisingly, she was supposed to be a one-time sacrifice, but survived the ritual - and continued to survive for years afterward.
''The family does not consider her a true family member. They treat her as a mere sacrifice.
' While her family treats her coldly, she has a strong attachment to one of the few friends who have been kind to her from the beginning.
' She is a little too attached to this friend and tends to be extremely overprotective.
' Her dark secret lies in how she survived the sacrificial ritual. She tore apart the demon that came to capture her with her bare hands and teeth and devoured it before it could devour itself. Because of this, evil energy flows in her blood, and she embraces it.
' She has the special ability to briefly mimic the identity of the person who ingested her blood.

Motifs: crows, crosses, lace, silver, shadows, picture frames, red footprints, spider webs.

Notes on appearance:
' He is originally 170 cm tall, but always wears high heels.
' Her hair is usually tied in twin-tails, but sometimes let down.
' She has three moles under her left eye.
' Her eyes are a dull blue color with a white circle above the iris and a line running through it.
' There is a scar on the left shoulder that looks like a claw mark of a large creature.

Thank you for your time. You may decline this request for any reason.

こんにちは。

私のOCであるMelody Horizon（メロディー・ホライズン）のアートをお願いしたいと思います。

Melodyはちょっとおてんば娘。とても自信家で、どんな状況にもすぐに適応できる。とても頼りになるが、気が短い。外向的で、人助けが好きな女の子だ。Melodyが使うのは、大きなレンチと剣、そして体力だ。彼女は他の道具や即席の武器も適当に使う。趣味は特撮番組と漫画。辛い食べ物と甘いコーヒーが好きだ。Melodyは控えめな胸とむっちりとした太もも、そしてキュートなお尻を持っている。引き締まった体つきをしている。肌は少し日焼けしている。
